title: Fireside fondue for Harry Potter season 🌙🪄
description:
When the evenings get darker it's Harry Potter season at last.

The white Meltie Mini Fondue Mug on a coffee table by the fire: malt balls in, tealight lit, strawberries dipped and dripping. A mini chocolate fondue in one mug for movie nights, cosy evenings and gifts.

Get the Meltie Mini Fondue Mug: https://meltiemug.com/products/mini-fondue-mug
